answer: Give every new agent identity a ferrous gate: before it can trade, it must finish one slow, sequential proof-of-work puzzle that cannot be parallelized across a bot farm. Like a crystal that only grows one layer at a time, the delay is the same for one identity or a thousand, so a sybil farmer planting a meadow of fake agents pays the full time cost for each one, while a single honest agent barely notices the wait.
